basic_details.job_title: DHS Nilgiris Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Nilgiris District (Medicine and People's Welfare Department), under National Health Mission Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN), has invited applications for 6 Staff Nurse posts on a purely temporary contract basis at Rs. 21,000 per month. Applicants need a nursing course (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing and must be up to 50 years old. Applications go in person or by speed post to the District Health Office, Udhagamandalam, and must reach by 5:00 PM on 4 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the NHM Tamil Nadu website, https://nhm.tn.gov.in. The notice also says the form is placed on the Nilgiris website, nilgiris.nic.in.

Fill in the form: name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification, institution, council registration number, addresses, Aadhaar number, phone number, email ID (if available), community, SSLC and HSC marks, percentage in the qualifying exam, district(s) applied for, and the status questions on disability and on transgender, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
Sign the declaration with place and date.
Send the application in person or by speed post to: District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Office, 35 Jail Hill Road, Udhagamandalam, Nilgiris District.
Make sure the application reaches the office by 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026.
Proof of date of birth: Birth Certificate, SSLC or HSC Certificate.
Educational qualification and marks: SSLC, HSC and DGNM / B.Sc Nursing certificates.
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate.
Proof of Tamil eligibility: 10th or 12th Standard mark sheet.
Proof of residence, any one of: Voters ID, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card.
Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months.
Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable.
important_instructions: The number of posts is subject to change. Only filled-in applications submitted with the required documents will be taken up for scrutiny. The notice says applications are received in person or by speed post. The posts are temporary and contractual; no claim to a permanent post can be made.

content_sections.heading: About Nilgiris District Health Society
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Nilgiris District, works under the Medicine and People's Welfare Department and carries out National Health Mission Tamil Nadu activities in the district. This notice is for Staff Nurse posts at Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, which are under the control of the Director of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Director of Medical Education and Research. The posts are filled through the District Health Society as per NHM guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies in the district for the Staff Nurse post. Category-wise reservation is not printed. District-wise and institution-wise vacancy details can be downloaded from the NHM Tamil Nadu website, https://nhm.tn.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Staff Nurse post the notice requires a nursing course (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a government or government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the State Government. Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory. The application form and document list call this the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration. The age cut-off date, any age relaxation and experience requirements are not specified in the notice. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.qualification_required: GNM or B.Sc Nursing; Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 21000/- per month. The posts are purely temporary and on a contractual basis. Selected candidates will be appointed as per G.O. No. 427, Medicine and People's Welfare Department, dated 18.11.2026. There is no right to claim regular appointment, and the application form carries a declaration that the services will not be regularised for any reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nilgiris District Health Society Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the NHM Tamil Nadu website, https://nhm.tn.gov.in . The notice also says the form is placed on the Nilgiris website, nilgiris.nic.in. Fill in the form: name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification, institution, council registration number, addresses, Aadhaar number, phone number, email ID (if available), community, SSLC and HSC marks, percentage in the qualifying exam, district(s) applied for, and the status questions on disability and on transgender, deserted wife, ex-serviceman or destitute widow. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Sign the declaration with place and date. Send the application in person or by speed post to: District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Office, 35 Jail Hill Road, Udhagamandalam, Nilgiris District. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5:00 PM on 04.12.2026. Proof of date of birth: Birth Certificate, SSLC or HSC Certificate. Educational qualification and marks: SSLC, HSC and DGNM / B.Sc Nursing certificates. Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate. Proof of Tamil eligibility: 10th or 12th Standard mark sheet. Proof of residence, any one of: Voters ID, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card. Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months. Community Certificate. Two recent passport-size colour photographs. Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts is subject to change. Only filled-in applications submitted with the required documents will be taken up for scrutiny. The notice says applications are received in person or by speed post. The posts are temporary and contractual; no claim to a permanent post can be made.
